title: When the Cellar Burns
author: Sable Blackwood
blurb: Mara Villalobos, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
